localId.description: Local ID of the task. This ID is local to the corresponding page or blog post.

spaceId.description: ID of the space the task is in.

pageId.description: ID of the page the task is in.

blogPostId.description: ID of the blog post the task is in.

createdBy.description: Account ID of the user who created this task.

assignedTo.description: Account ID of the user to whom this task is assigned.

completedBy.description: Account ID of the user who completed this task.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the task was created. In format "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ".

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the task was updated. In format "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ".

dueAt.description: Date and time when the task is due. In format "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ".

completedAt.description: Date and time when the task was completed. In format "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ".
